channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent and the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) are taking action against a tax strategy reportedly used by the wealthy to avoid capital gains taxes. This strategy involves investing in certain Exchange Traded Funds… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: IG Group Shares Plunge After Slashed Future Guidance
item.description: Shares of the spreadbetter IG Group experienced a significant decline, diving 27% after the company drastically reduced its financial guidance for 2026. The trading platform's announcement led to a substantial drop in its stock value. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Fuel Prices Rise, Impacting Consumers and Businesses
item.description: Rising fuel prices are increasing costs for consumers and businesses, including charities. US refiners are reportedly experiencing windfall profits due to these escalating fuel costs, which are influenced by global conflicts. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Etihad Rail Adds Trains Between Abu Dhabi and Dubai
item.description: Etihad Rail has launched a train service connecting Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Following a surge in demand, the company has added six extra trains to the route. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Jobs Market Slows Ahead of Midterm Elections
item.description: The United States jobs market experienced a significant slowdown, with employers pausing hiring as unemployment rose slightly. This development occurred just a month before the midterm elections. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: US mortgage rates have climbed to their highest level in nearly three years. The increase has implications for potential homebuyers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Leaders from the G7 nations have agreed to release 100 million barrels of diesel and other reserves through the International Energy Agency (IEA) in response to rising global fuel prices. The decision follows pressure from the United… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: Jammu and Kashmir has notified its Electric Vehicle Policy 2026, aiming to promote green transportation. The policy targets the adoption of 1.4 lakh electric vehicles by 2032. The notification was met with congratulations from Chief… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: India's GST Revenue Surges Past ₹2 Lakh Crore in September
item.description: Goods and Services Tax (GST) revenue in India surpassed ₹2 lakh crore in September. Andhra Pradesh specifically recorded a 14.10% increase in its GST collections for the same month. This marks a significant rise in national tax revenue. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jammu and Kashmir auctions two mineral blocks
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir has successfully auctioned two mineral blocks, marking a significant development in the region's mining sector. This event is described as a "historic first" for J&K, signaling the commencement of mining development. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone reported an 11% year-on-year increase in cargo volume for September, reaching 46 million metric tons (MMT). For the first half of the fiscal year 2027 (H1 FY27), the company's cargo volume grew by 15%… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Shares of major Indian auto manufacturers, including Bajaj Auto, Mahindra & Mahindra (M&M), and Hero MotoCorp, experienced a significant decline, with Bajaj Auto shares falling over 7% and others skidding up to 6%. The downturn is linked… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Airtel Money IPO prices shares at £1.96, valuing it at £5.3 billion
item.description: Airtel Money has priced its Initial Public Offering (IPO) at £1.96 per share, valuing the company at £5.3 billion. This offering is noted as London's largest IPO in five years. Investors are preparing to sell shares in the African fintech. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: The State Bank of India (SBI) purchased nearly 40% of Reliance Industries' debt sale, which amounted to $1.35 billion (approximately ₹13,000 crore). SBI led the demand for this bond sale. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Shares of Indian auto companies declined in September after reaching record highs in August. Hyundai reported record sales for September, selling 77,916 units, a significant increase from previous periods. Other auto companies also saw… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.description: Apple is projected to sell 6 million units of its foldable iPhone Duo this year, with each unit priced at $1,999. This sales target is set against a backdrop of IDC predictions forecasting a 13% growth in the overall foldable phone market… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Billionaire Peter Thiel is the undisclosed buyer of Casa Encantada, a mega-mansion in Bel-Air, for $130 million. The property has a history of being troubled. The Wall Street Journal reported that Thiel was behind the purchase, while the… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: India's upcoming CAFE-III norms are set to influence consumer choices for petrol, hybrid, and electric vehicles by 2027. Auto industry veterans have stated that these norms will create pathways for the industry to offer a variety of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Middle East Crude Oil Exports Reach Prewar Levels, Shipments Constrained
item.description: Middle East crude oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz have returned to prewar levels, according to analysts. Despite this increase in crude oil shipments, overall fuel shipments from the region remain constrained. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: OpenAI announced on Thursday that it has terminated the employment of three researchers. The company stated that the researchers were fired for allegedly mishandling "sensitive information" and violating company policies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: US Treasury Yields Hit 24-Year Highs, Stocks Show Resilience
item.description: US 10-year Treasury yields surged to their highest level since 2002, reaching 24-year highs, while US stocks showed resilience and inched up. Despite the surge in yields, stock markets have held up. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Shein Shares Drop After Quarterly Profit Falls Sharply
item.description: Shares of the fast-fashion platform Shein experienced a 6% decline following a 67% slide in quarterly profit. The company's shares also saw a significant drop during their initial public offering (IPO) debut in Hong Kong. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: ANZ Bank Changes Auditor After 57 Years
item.description: ANZ Bank has changed its auditor, ending a 57-year relationship with KPMG. The specific reasons for the change were not detailed in the coverage provided. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
